Subject: Re: corporate block - loyalty points & rate addendum

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for confirming the 28-room block for the October 18 exec workshop. Two quick items from group sales before we finalize the contract:

1) Corporate rate override for senior execs — your team requested the ability to override the negotiated rate for up to 6 senior travelers (to use suite inventory or upgraded category) while keeping the remainder on the contracted group rate. We can do this, but we need the names and which rooms should be posted to masterbill vs. individual folios.

2) Loyalty redemption — a few execs want to redeem Harbor loyalty points on top of the corporate rate. Harbor policy is to allow point redemption on a per-folio basis, but group rate restrictions apply if the room is posted to the master bill. We can allow point redemption if the room is billed individually and the attached rate addendum is signed.

Attached: Harbor_rate_addendum.pdf (rate override terms), sample folio posting matrix.

If you can send the list of prioritized names and whether each should be on master bill by EOD Monday, we will lock the inventory and mark the 6 suite upgrades as held.

Best,
Samantha Holt
Group Sales Manager | Harbor Hotels

Samantha — thanks for the clarity and the addendum. A few operational notes from our side so we can make this clean at check-in: 

- We will have 28 rooms on the master bill for the workshop; however, up to 6 executives may request suite upgrades and pay for their rooms individually. Those 6 rooms should be removed from the master bill and posted as individual folios if they choose upgrades or loyalty redemptions.
- Please confirm the exact code/line item we should look for on the master bill vs. individual folio so our travel ops (cc'd) can reconcile on arrival.
- Attached is the working attendee manifest (Redwood_exec_block_manifest.xlsx). Marissa will collect loyalty numbers and preferred room types; Ben will confirm billing approvals for any third-party charges.

Action items:
- Samantha: Confirm the folio posting code and whether Harbor will permit points redemption at check-in for rooms originally contracted to the group rate but converted to individual folios.
- Marissa: I need the list of execs who want upgraded rooms by next Tuesday (21 Sep).
- Ben: Can you confirm we can authorize third-party folio charges for suites and upgrades when needed?

If Harbor can provide a short clause in the addendum explicitly allowing point redemption on converted folios, we can route the executed addendum through procurement and finish the DocuSign today.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Karthik / Marissa — quick follow-up after speaking with revenue. Summary below and I'm attaching a one-paragraph addendum we can tack onto the group contract: 

- Harbor is OK to release up to 6 suites for upgrade requests. If a guest requests an upgrade at or before check-in and we remove that room from the master bill, they may redeem Harbor loyalty points on their individual folio.
- If the room remains on the master bill, points cannot be redeemed.
- Folio posting code for converted rooms: HARV-GRP-CONV (this will appear as a separate line on the master invoice; converted folios will carry their own folio numbers).

We've attached Harbor_rate_addendum.pdf (updated with the explicit loyalty clause) and a short signature page for your approvals. Once the addendum is signed we will mark the suites as 'held pending signatures' through Oct 1.
